criticisms.description: The filename-based self-controller exemption recognized the initial C2_D1_006 projection but not the legitimate resumed C2_D1_006_RETRY2 projection. LOCK again failed before its assertions.
criticisms.repair_boundary: Bind the exemption to the persisted current controller/resource-claim PID-plus-creation identity and its exact live parent chain, never to an invocation-name substring.

criticisms.description: The retry wrapper failed before serializing PID/timing/exit metadata because its start-time variable was not initialized. The incomplete retry envelope correctly refused to infer PASS.
criticisms.repair_boundary: Use a small Python supervisor with initialization before spawn and unconditional finally-path metadata publication. A missing observed exit remains FAIL.
